newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan July gas oil output hits record high - MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan July gas oil output hits record high - MITI.

text.p: Japan's gas oil production in July hit a record high of 4.2 million kilolitres, up 8.1 percent from the same period a year earlier, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Monday.
This represents an increase of about 18.7 percent from June when output reached 3.5 million kl, a MITI official told reporters.
The MITI official attributed the rise in gas oil production to a substantial increase in the number of newly registered automobiles which run on diesel.
Gasoline production in July rose a sharp 10.9 percent from the same period a year earlier and amounted to 4.6 million kl, a record high for the month, MITI said.
